rules: Do not pad output to hit arbitrary line counts.
Do not promise hidden or background work.
Do not emit fake hashes, checksums, benchmarks, or test results.
Prefer concrete file paths, symbols, commands, and verification evidence over hype.

preferred_substitutions.robust: name the failure mode and the handling logic
preferred_substitutions.scalable: name the likely bottleneck and the mitigation
preferred_substitutions.secure: name the threat and the concrete control
preferred_substitutions.clean architecture: name the modules and dependency direction
preferred_substitutions.production ready: name the missing checks, docs, and deployment steps
